brash.label: Brash
brash.text: Fights harder in a close-range body (melee frame or arms).

calm.label: Calm
calm.text: Steadier when built to guard others (guardian frame or arms).

stubborn.label: Stubborn
stubborn.text: Likes a heavy body that will not budge (heavy frame, arms or legs).

curious.label: Curious
curious.text: Livelier in a frame it did not use in its last battle.

patient.label: Patient
patient.text: Gathers itself in the back row before it acts.

loyal.label: Loyal
loyal.text: Steadier beside an ally it fought with in its last battle.

spirits.name: Pyra
spirits.title: the Emberling
spirits.description: A quick-tempered ember who wants to be where the sparks fly.

trait.name: Kindle
trait.text: Her attacks set the target Burning (+1 stack).

awakening.name: Wildfire
awakening.text: When she defeats an enemy, every remaining enemy catches Burn (+1 stack).

spirits.name: Neris
spirits.title: the Calm Tide
spirits.description: Patient and watchful. Pressure only makes her tide rise.

trait.name: Tide Memory
trait.text: When struck, gains Ward equal to her RES (once between her turns).

awakening.name: Floodwall
awakening.text: The first time her HP falls below half, she and every ally gain Ward equal to her RES.

spirits.name: Odo
spirits.title: the Gravemind
spirits.description: An old stone spirit. Slow to move, slower to fall.

trait.name: Bedrock
trait.text: +3 DEF and +3 RES while standing in the front row.

awakening.name: Rumble
awakening.text: Every blow he takes fills his action gauge by 20: the harder he is pressed, the sooner he answers.

spirits.name: Sefa
spirits.title: the Zephra
spirits.description: A restless squall that wants to try every body once.

trait.name: Squall
trait.text: Her attacks leave the target Soaked for 2 turns.

awakening.name: Tailwind
awakening.text: After each of her attacks, every ally's action gauge fills by 12.

spirits.name: Volta
spirits.title: the Sparkwright
spirits.description: A crackling spark who waits for the perfect moment, then strikes twice.

trait.name: Conduction
trait.text: Her hits on a Soaked enemy jolt it again for half her MAG.

awakening.name: Overcharge
awakening.text: Her hits on a Soaked enemy also Stun it (once every 3 of her turns).

spirits.name: Briar
spirits.title: the Thornheart
spirits.description: A bramble spirit that grew around a fallen friend's vessel. Slow to trust; never lets go.

trait.name: Thorns
trait.text: When struck by an attack, lashes the attacker for 2 plus half her DEF.

awakening.name: Bloom
awakening.text: The first time her HP falls below half, she and every ally gain Regen for 3 turns.

trait.name: Mossback
trait.text: The first time its HP falls below half, it heals 6.

trait.name: Grit
trait.text: +2 DEF while standing in the front row.

trait.name: Spray
trait.text: Its attacks leave the target Soaked for 2 turns.

trait.name: Kindle
trait.text: Its attacks set the target Burning (+1 stack).

trait.name: Overgrowth
trait.text: Heals 5 HP at the start of each of its turns.
